description: Expand a recurring event or iCalendar RRULE ("every 2nd Tuesday", "Mon/Wed until June") into concrete dates and times in a time zone, DST-aware, with optional excluded dates. Use for repeating meetings, calendar invites and schedules. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

start.description: Local start date or datetime in timezone, e.g. 2026-01-01T10:00
